source.title: Feralas Mission VI: Harpy Intelligence
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Ruins of Ravenwind. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Anadelle there and return to me.
source.objective: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Anadelle in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion at the broken gazebo in the Ruins of Ravenwind and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
